target_hardware.RAM: 2 GB DDR3/DDR4 (1856 MB usable kernel space)

malware_and_botnets.description: Critical security threats, residential proxy botnets, and trojanized IPTV clients disguised as free streaming apps (e.g., MagisTV / SkyLive clones). These establish unauthorized persistent VPN/proxy tunnels, hijack up to 30% continuous CPU across all 4 Cortex-A53 cores, and expose the home LAN.

com.haxsmart.skylive.cpu_impact: ~30% continuous CPU hijack across Cortex-A53 cores
com.haxsmart.skylive.behavior: Establishes a hidden persistent VPN/proxy tunnel (BIND_VPN_SERVICE) and background C2 daemon on boot (RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED), turning the TV Box into an exit node for residential proxy botnets while throttling legitimate media decoding.
com.haxsmart.skylive.mitigation: Immediate full removal via 'pm clear com.haxsmart.skylive' followed by 'pm uninstall --user 0 com.haxsmart.skylive'.

operator_telemetry_and_locks.description: ISP/Operator provisioning locks, custom high-RAM launchers, TR-069/TR-369 remote management (CWMP/USP) agents, XMPP remote command listeners, forced OTA updaters, and continuous logcat telemetry daemons.
operator_telemetry_and_locks.firmware_note: IMPORTANT: Skyworth firmware protects 'ar.com.flow.*' packages at the PackageManagerService level with a hardcoded 'pm uninstall' whitelist (returning DELETE_FAILED_INTERNAL_ERROR). To neutralize them without root, you MUST execute 'pm clear <pkg>' followed by 'pm suspend --user 0 <pkg>' and 'cmd appops set <pkg> RUN_IN_BACKGROUND ignore'.

ar.com.flow.provisioncheck.behavior: Queries operator ACS servers to verify active subscription status and draws a persistent full-screen lock overlay (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW) if the STB is used standalone.
ar.com.flow.provisioncheck.mitigation: Protected by Skyworth pm uninstall whitelist. Neutralize via 'pm clear ar.com.flow.provisioncheck' + 'pm suspend --user 0 ar.com.flow.provisioncheck' + 'appops set ar.com.flow.provisioncheck SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW deny'.

ar.com.flow.androidtv_stb.behavior: Monolithic operator UI, EPG middleware, and background DRM/heartbeat service consuming over 200 MB of Resident Set Size (RSS) RAM continuously.
ar.com.flow.androidtv_stb.mitigation: Protected by Skyworth pm uninstall whitelist. Replace with a lightweight launcher or Google TV Home, then execute 'pm clear ar.com.flow.androidtv_stb' + 'pm suspend --user 0 ar.com.flow.androidtv_stb'.

ar.com.flow.radiosymusica.common_name: Flow Radios y Musica Content Applet
ar.com.flow.radiosymusica.behavior: Operator audio streaming applet that preloads background metadata receivers on boot.
ar.com.flow.radiosymusica.mitigation: Protected by Skyworth pm uninstall whitelist. Neutralize via 'pm clear ar.com.flow.radiosymusica' + 'pm suspend --user 0 ar.com.flow.radiosymusica'.

com.skyworth.android.tr069.common_name: Skyworth TR-069 CWMP Remote Management Agent
com.skyworth.android.tr069.behavior: Implements CPE WAN Management Protocol (CWMP), allowing remote ISP servers to inspect device state, push silent configurations, and re-enable operator locks.
com.skyworth.android.tr069.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

com.sdt.android.tr369.behavior: Next-generation User Services Platform (USP / TR-369) persistent telemetry and remote control daemon.
com.sdt.android.tr369.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

com.skyworth.xmppservice.behavior: Maintains an open XMPP socket to vendor cloud servers to trigger real-time TR-069/TR-369 wakeups and remote diagnostics.
com.skyworth.xmppservice.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

com.skyworth.update.behavior: Polls for vendor firmware updates that can overwrite debloat states and re-lock the bootloader/launcher.
com.skyworth.update.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

com.sdt.ota.behavior: Background OTA package downloader and verifier service.
com.sdt.ota.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

com.skyworthdigital.diagnose.behavior: Collects hardware metrics, network topology, and package inventories for remote operator inspection.
com.skyworthdigital.diagnose.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

com.skyworth.skylogcatservice.behavior: Continuously dumps system logcat buffers to flash storage, causing unnecessary eMMC I/O wear and CPU wakeups.
com.skyworth.skylogcatservice.mitigation: Disable/uninstall for user 0 ('pm clear', 'pm disable-user --user 0', 'pm uninstall --user 0').

heavy_preloads_optional.description: Heavy commercial streaming preloads that run persistent background Cobalt/WebView engines or DRM daemons even when idle. Suspending these is optional and recommended when substituting with lightweight open-source alternatives.

replacement_recommendations.com.google.android.youtube.tv: Replace with SmartTube (com.liskovsoft.smarttubetv.beta / .stable) — open-source, zero background telemetry, built-in SponsorBlock/AdBlock, and ~60% lower RAM footprint than the official Cobalt engine.
replacement_recommendations.com.google.android.videos: Google Play Movies & TV / Google TV VOD daemon — safely suspended if using local media players (Nova Video Player, VLC) or Stremio/CloudStream.
replacement_recommendations.com.netflix.ninja: Official Netflix Android TV daemon — keeps background ESN/Widevine pre-warmed services in RAM; suspend if not actively subscribed.

com.google.android.youtube.tv.common_name: Official YouTube for Android TV (Cobalt Engine)
com.google.android.youtube.tv.behavior: Runs a heavy Cobalt browser runtime that stays cached in RAM and preloads ad-serving buffers.
com.google.android.youtube.tv.mitigation: Optional: 'pm clear com.google.android.youtube.tv' + 'pm suspend --user 0 com.google.android.youtube.tv' after installing SmartTube.

com.google.android.videos.behavior: Background content recommendation sync and storefront service.

com.netflix.ninja.open_source_replacement: CloudStream / Stremio / Kodi (if Netflix subscription is unused)
com.netflix.ninja.behavior: Pre-allocates DRM buffers and partner partner-key listeners on Android TV boot.
